lines: In Spring, vegetation turns green, flowers bloom, birds sing and most of the environment is alive and beautiful. The sky is usually blue. There are a few clouds. The weather is usually warm, and sunny. It is rarely rainy.

lines: In Summer, all the vegetation is green. There are flowers everywhere. The sky looks bluer and brighter. The sun looks very orange. It is very hot. It is sometimes cloudy and rainy, too. People usually take their vacation during this season. They like to go to the beach and get suntan. Others prefer to go to the mountains away from the noisy cities.

lines: In Autumn, the leaves of the trees turn yellow, orange and brown. Then, they fall on the ground forming a beautiful carpet of all colors. The weather turns colder. Days are cloudy and windy. People start wearing warmer clothes like: coats, jackets, gloves and scarfs.

blocks.text: In Winter the trees have no leaves. Only pines and evergreen trees keep green and fresh. The weather turns colder, windy, foggy and snowy. Children, young people and even older people enjoy playing in the snow. People keep warmer by wearing boots, gloves, thick coats or jackets and wool scarfs and caps. You can find Santa Claus everywhere talking to people, giving gifts and candies away and hugging them. You can hear Christmas songs everywhere. People decorate their offices, schools, streets, houses and the shopping centers with Christmas crafts and Christmas trees. Everybody is waiting for Jesus Christ to be born again in their hearts.
